tasks.spec:
Implement the minimum deny-by-default claim gate identified in the ADR-0019 admission pass for Bifrost hub hardening. The claim gate must check canonical Beads claim evidence and caller identity, reject replay/stale/malformed/unavailable cases, and produce auditable evidence. Do not enable Ringside write operations merely by completing implementation; enablement requires the separately recorded proof verdict.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Fixtures prove allowed claim, absent claim, wrong claimant, replay/stale claim, malformed authority envelope, and unavailable Beads behavior
2. All failures deny writes
3. Successful proof emits stable evidence tied to a Beads identifier and claimant identity
4. Ringside remains read-only unless the proof passes and an explicit approval is recorded
5. Artifact, verification, commit, push, revocation/rollback are recorded
